oman.input: abs of horizontal acceleration (ax, ay), not frequency weighted
oman.note: K0 = median per-person K on TU Delft at 100 Hz with the 0.63 Hz input low-pass (48.7 without it). Checked by ml/verify/oman_tudelft.py

wf.standard: ISO 2631-1:1997 Wf (motion sickness), applied to x, y, z for features
wf.discretization: bilinear s = 2 fs (1 - z^-1)/(1 + z^-1) per section, no prewarp, sections in order Hh, Hl, Ht, Hs
wf.note: high-pass at 0.08 Hz removes gravity and sensor tilt from the weighted features; the Oman input is not weighted

events.note: Thresholds are ride-discomfort onsets from bus passenger studies (1.5 and -0.75: He et al. 2013; 2.0: Nguyen et al. 2019), not motion sickness thresholds. An event is counted when the low-passed acceleration crosses the threshold and is counted again only after it has come back by rearm_margin (hysteresis, own choice, feature_order v3); without it one brake hovering at -0.75 was counted several times (comma2k19: 7.0 vs 5.3 per 5 min).

mssq.note: sens = clip(exp(sens_coef * (mssq - norm_mean) / norm_sd), sens_min, sens_max). Golding 2006 norms. TU Delft LOPO MAE: 1.32 without MSSQ, 1.26 with this rule
